just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D5 and dwells most on D in Bastenegar. The line peaks at Ds5 (611.3 Hz) at 0:35.8. It closes on D5, not the tonic (D5 → D5 → Ds5 → D5 → D5 → D5).
